The handler's `uniqueGuests` filter only removes emails matching existing attendees or blacklist, not duplicates within the request, so `['a@b.com','a@b.com']` would be inserted twice via createMany. Mechanism fully verifiable from the diff.

adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: server-side input schema `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts` defines `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no uniqueness check. The client-only uniqueness refine exists only inside `AddGuestsDialog.tsx` (local `ZAddGuestsInputSchema`), so it can be bypassed by calling the tRPC mutation directly. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` filters out existing attendees and blacklisted emails but does not deduplicate within the provided `guests` array, so `['a@b.com','a@b.com']` will remain duplicated and be passed to `attendees.createMany`, potentially inserting duplicate attendee rows and resulting in duplicated attendees downstream.
